title: A Interior for the Inventory
author: Mirabel Ashgrove
blurb: Quentin Lockridge, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
